name: DropStick Simulator
summary:
DropStick Simulator faithfully recreates the physical DropStick training experience — designed to enhance reflexes and hand-eye coordination.

With realistic falling physics, precise detection, and full mixed reality support, every stick behaves just like the real thing, challenging your reaction time in your own space.

This is not an arcade game or competitive experience.
It’s focused training — pure and distraction-free.

Falling physics based on the original DropStick.
